name: 社交接口库
description: 预置 80+ 社交接口：账户 cookie 登录、好友、私聊、群聊、动态、搜索、通知、收藏、文件、举报、统计；onlyId 定身份，表默认无主键。

routes.name: 更新资料
routes.summary: 更新昵称、头像、简介、性别、地区
routes.script:
EXEC UPDATE {{t:user}} SET nickname = IFNULL({{body.nickname}}, nickname), avatar = IFNULL({{body.avatar}}, avatar), bio = IFNULL({{body.bio}}, bio), gender = IFNULL({{body.gender}}, gender), region = IFNULL({{body.region}}, region), updated_at = NOW() WHERE only_id = {{user.onlyId}};
RETURN 200 { "ok": true, "onlyId": {{user.onlyId}} };

LET $rows = QUERY SELECT b.blocked_only_id AS only_id, b.reason, b.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM {{t:block}} b LEFT JOIN {{t:user}} u ON u.only_id = b.blocked_only_id WHERE b.only_id = {{user.onlyId}} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC;

routes.name: 好友推荐
routes.script:
LET $rows = QUERY SELECT only_id, nickname, avatar, region, last_seen_at FROM {{t:user}} WHERE status = 1 AND allow_search = 1 AND only_id != {{user.onlyId}} AND only_id NOT IN (SELECT friend_only_id FROM {{t:friend}} WHERE owner_only_id = {{user.onlyId}}) ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 10;
RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };

docs.description: 所有写操作都用当前 token 的 user.onlyId，不接受请求体伪造身份。

routes.name: 会话列表
routes.script:
LET $rows = QUERY SELECT c.conv_id, c.last_message, c.last_at, c.created_at, CASE WHEN c.owner_only_id = {{user.onlyId}} THEN c.peer_only_id ELSE c.owner_only_id END AS peer_only_id, u.nickname AS peer_name, u.avatar AS peer_avatar FROM {{t:conv}} c LEFT JOIN {{t:user}} u ON u.only_id = CASE WHEN c.owner_only_id = {{user.onlyId}} THEN c.peer_only_id ELSE c.owner_only_id END WHERE c.owner_only_id = {{user.onlyId}} OR c.peer_only_id = {{user.onlyId}} ORDER BY c.last_at DESC;
RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };

RETURN 200 { "rows": $rows.rows };
